requirements: Reject default, empty, or shared production credentials.
Require TLS and an OIDC/JWT authentication path.
Keep PostgreSQL, MinIO, Nessie, Trino, and Dagster off public host interfaces.
Use separate least-privilege identities for API, orchestration, query, catalog, and maintenance workloads.
Enable backend-native authorization and audit facilities and fail readiness on policy drift.
Render secret files with mode 0600 and retain durable audit evidence for privileged mutations.
development_defaults: Generated credentials and convenient host ports are for a trusted local development machine only.
Current service images and tags are implementation metadata, not release artifact guarantees.
production.reason: Mandatory HTTP authorization, scoped workload identities, and backend-native readiness contributors remain unverified; the production preflight report currently surfaces these as failed or unavailable.
production.release_cut_note: production.status is required_before_release because release BOM resolution, supply-chain checks, and final release-cut evidence are outside this support boundary.
